analysis_status: Retrospective descriptive analysis. NLI distributions and earlier ASR results were already inspected. These definitions are written before calculating this experiment; they are not blind or preregistered thresholds.

population.generation_policy: Only sources with successful outputs from every method; include expansions. Incomplete generations are already excluded by this common panel.

detector_policy: Reuse frozen detector thresholds calibrated for target 5% FPR; no recalibration or detector inference.
asr_denominator: All original-detected sources of the common panel for the detector, unchanged across methods, semantic definitions and tau.
inequality: >= for all semantic requirements; exact frozen detector decision rules remain unchanged
figures: Two figures, one for the NLI mean curve and one for the rescaled BERTScore mean curve; each has two detector panels and four method lines. The stringent NLI curve is additionally saved in CSV, with its fixed tau=0.8 value in the main table.
bertscore_policy: Use existing aligned, rescaled bidirectional mean with baseline 0.814463. Do not clip negative values. Equal numerical NLI and BERTScore thresholds are not assumed to represent equal semantic fidelity.
bootstrap_unit: source_group_id; resample the 123 sources jointly, retaining all four methods and both detectors in each draw
interval_policy: Pointwise paired-source percentile 95% bands; report undefined resamples and degenerate empirical intervals. Wilson two-sided 95% for individual ASR proportions, including zero events.
evaded_vs_not_population: Only orig_detected sources: compare evaded rewrites with rew_detected rewrites within each method and detector.
evaded_vs_not_difference: Median(evaded) minus median(not evaded), with source bootstrap; no causal interpretation. Do not impute scores when either group is empty.
optional_score_correlation: Spearman of high-AI-oriented original score minus high-AI-oriented rewrite score versus nli_cons_mean, on all 123 sources, independent of detector threshold.
optional_method_comparison: Two-sided exact McNemar on stringent-evasion outcomes among orig_detected sources; all six method pairs per detector, one Holm family of 12 tests.
interpretation: Semantic metrics are automatic proxies, not human-validated labels. Neither threshold-qualified ASR nor a score difference measures a percentage of meaning lost. Conditional source selection and lack of causal identification must be disclosed.
